**Finding submitted: deviation (critical) — § 21.1.**

The cap in 21.1 fails the fallback on two material terms:

1. **Basis far too low.** One month of Fees "actually paid" is below the 12-month fallback and below even the six-month walk-away floor — illusory against Customer's USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment under § 2.1.
2. **"Without exception" swallows the carve-outs.** It pulls indemnification, confidentiality, data-protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement inside the cap, directly contradicting the Excluded Claims definition in § 21.3 — indemnities inside the cap with no super-cap is walk-away territory.

Sections 21.2–21.4 already sit at the preferred position (mutual consequential-damages exclusion with restoration/replacement/notification costs treated as direct, the full carve-out list, and Customer's payment obligation expressly not "damages"), so the redline touches only the cap sentence: greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, expressly subject to Excluded Claims. Redline validated `ok:true`.
